messages:
jamie: FYI saw 99p latency spikes on shared GPUs in rack-17 correlated with TOR egress bursts after vizco went live on a fractional slice.

oliver: link to chart?

jamie: telemetry query: /api/query?m=egress_bytes_per_sec&rack=rack-17&window=5m -> top src is vizco streaming. TOR egress hit ~820Mbps.

rachel: vizco flipped on their prefetcher yesterday, that tracks.

jamie: small egress bumps -> NVLINK stalls -> slab evictions -> model tails. We need a mitigation that avoids full node drains.

ankur: proposal: add egress-based soft-evac rule for fractional/shared slices. If TOR egress >750Mbps for >30s: 1) throttle tenant egress to 600Mbps for 2m; 2) if still over threshold -> annotate slice as soft-evacuate and avoid packing new fractional allocs on that rack; existing jobs continue with backpressure. Cooldown 10m to avoid oscillation.

oliver: Two concerns: KV cache churn and cost shift to fallback pools.

rachel: KV-winback TTL can reduce cold misses during short evacuations. For costs: surges above SLA should be billable to tenant; otherwise infra absorbs during canary. PM/billing to confirm.

jamie: Implementation quick sketch: scheduler emits tor.egress metric -> routing annotator sets slice annotation -> allocator respects annotation and stops packing new fractional allocs. Expose infra.evacuate_on_egress flag for rollout.

ankur: Add gating: reserved/dedicated slices excluded. Also add alert if evacuation rate >3 racks/hour.

oliver: Canary plan: enable in eu-west-1 on low-traffic racks, run synthetic 3m burst probe to measure KV miss delta and token cost.

jamie: Runbook snippets: 
```
# annotate slice to soft-evacuate
POST /allocator/v1/slice/annotate {"slice":"slice-1234","annotation":"soft-evacuate:egress-750"}
# prevent new packs to rack
kubectl label nodes rack-17 infra.evacuate=true --overwrite
```

rachel: Console needs to show projected cost delta in rollout modal before enabling. Ops must approve.

ankur: I'll add the throttle pre-check and cooldown logic in allocator PR.

jamie: I'll draft the rollout doc and own the canary. Will post updates here.

sre-bot: [deploy-bot] rollout created: feature/egress-soft-evacuate -> staging -> eu-west-1 canary. https://deploys.internal/rollouts/1212 :rocket:
